metaDescription: CPT 99453 explained: the one-time RPM setup and patient education code. What counts, documentation, how often it can be billed and the 2026 rate.
summary: The one-time RPM code for setting up the monitoring device and teaching the patient how to use it.
time: Setup and education, no monthly minute threshold
frequency: Typically once per episode of care; confirm with your MAC
requirements: A practitioner order for remote monitoring and an established relationship with the patient
Record that the device was set up and the patient was taught to use it
A device that meets the FDA definition of a medical device
pitfalls: Billing setup again for a patient already within an episode of care
Billing without a documented order or consent

faqs.question: Can 99453 be billed every month?
faqs.answer: No. It is a setup code, usually reported once per episode of care, not monthly.

faqs.question: Does the patient need to be in the office for 99453?
faqs.answer: Setup and education can happen in person or remotely, but both must be documented in the record.
